Milky Punch

Served at: Perchta Day (Perchtenlauf)

Serves 6Prep 10 minCook 15 min

Milky Punch is a traditional warm beverage enjoyed during Perchta Day, a festive occasion celebrated in parts of Austria and Bavaria. This creamy, spiced punch is perfect for warming up during the chilly Perchtenlauf processions, where participants dress as Perchten to chase away winter spirits.

Ingredients

  • 4 cups (960 ml) whole milk
  • 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream
  • 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
  • 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
  • 1/4 cup (60 ml) rum or brandy (optional)
  • Whipped cream, for garnish
  • Ground cinnamon, for garnish

Method

  1. In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, heavy cream, and sugar over medium heat.
  2. Stir the mixture until the sugar dissolves completely and the milk is warm but not boiling, about 5 minutes.
  3. Add the vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves to the warm milk mixture, stirring well to combine.
  4. Continue heating the punch gently for another 5-7 minutes, allowing the spices to infuse the milk without boiling.
  5. Remove the saucepan from heat and, if desired, stir in the rum or brandy for an adult version.
  6. Ladle the milky punch into mugs or heatproof glasses.
  7. Top each serving with a dollop of whipped cream and a light sprinkle of ground cinnamon before serving.

Tips

  • Use whole milk and heavy cream for the creamiest texture; for a lighter version, substitute half-and-half for cream.
  • Adjust the amount of spices to your taste, adding more cinnamon or nutmeg for a stronger flavor.
  • For a non-alcoholic version, omit the rum or brandy and consider adding a cinnamon stick while heating for extra aroma.
